matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Arranging union representation and employer support for workplace union duties or activities.
Discover UK employment guidance for Trade union representative rights. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
Unions have the right to request access to workplaces to speak with workers whether or not:

you recognise the union

workers are members of a union

Unions have the right to request access to workplaces to:

facilitate collective bargaining

meet, support, represent, recruit or organise workers

You should:

respond within 15 working days of the union making the request

work with the union to agree on access

When you have reached an agreement, you should also facilitate any access. This can be:

in person, such as allowing union meetings in the workplace

digital, such as sending an email to workers on the union’s behalf

If you cannot agree on access to the workplace, the union can refer the case to the Central Arbitration Committee (CAC). The CAC will decide on whether the union can have access.

Read the guidance on workplace access for more information.
